summary: feat(interfere): wire PriorityRequestQueue + thermal gate for multi-user safety
expected_findings_themes: thermal gate threshold is configurable but the default 'heavy' should be calibrated per chassis
503 + Retry-After on overflow leaks no information about queue depth which can be a feature or bug
X-Interfere-Priority header is trusted from the client and could be abused to jump the queue
queue depth gauge + reject counter are the right SLO instruments for this admission-control surface
rationale: Concurrency + admission control + multi-user safety + new metrics. fd-correctness for admission ordering, fd-safety for the trusted-header risk, fd-performance for latency under thermal load, fd-architecture for the gate/queue boundary.
labeler_notes: Multi-domain commit; both backends should pull the full technical roster.
